data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nawfala', which means 'to be delightful or gracious'. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies the bestowal of Allah's blessings and mercy. The name Nawfalah carries the meaning “Delightful, Gracious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawfalah usually hope their child will grow to embody delightful, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
